meta.name: Terror Tuesday Extreme
meta.description:
Inspired by the Thai horror radio show "Angkhan Khlumpong," this series presents eight stories based on real-life experiences shared by listeners.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 20 Aug 2024 · Thailand · Language: Thai
Studio: BrandThink Cinema · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: English (from file names)

videos.title: Our Little Sister
videos.overview: Following her sister's death, a young woman copes with grief, only to discover that her mother has adopted a doll that seems to have a life of its own.

videos.title: Wedding Dress
videos.overview: With her job at risk, a tailor scrambles to alter an old dress in time for her client's wedding. But the garment's dreadful history begins to haunt her.

videos.title: Ode to My Family
videos.overview: When a young man finds a sealed room in his new home and discovers its terrifying story, the horrors of the past slowly creep into his family's lives.

videos.title: The Vow
videos.overview: An encounter with a vengeful goddess leaves two lovers with only one way to avoid certain death: reveal every secret they've been hiding from each other.

videos.title: Spectral Class
videos.overview: A teacher visits her missing student's unusual family and quickly becomes entangled in a hazy world of hallucinations and occult rituals.

videos.title: Girl Next Door
videos.overview: A man with a drug addiction finds himself drawn to a neighbor, who slips him a cryptic note with odd instructions. Soon, mysterious events plague him.

videos.title: Dear Granny
videos.overview: After vanishing under strange circumstances, a grandmother suddenly returns home. But her family realizes that she may no longer be who she was.

videos.title: Viral Curse
videos.overview: A mother must find a way to protect her young daughter when an eerie story from a radio program begins to mirror their reality.
